versions.content: Ability to access different event memories Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support diagnostic services to read or remove event entries from the configured event memory seperatly. Rationale: Advanced fault analysis ▽ △ Use Case: The development departments of the OEMs and Suppliers need as much as possible deeper fault/event analysis although the mechanics may have deleted the faults or may not need to know if there are more detailed root causes for an event or fault. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
